name: Corporate Memphis
garments: not a fashion look — an illustration style

media.title: Facebook/Meta, Slack and countless startup landing pages (2017–on)

reacts_against: stock photography's perceived fakeness, offering illustrated, deliberately "diverse"-looking flat figures instead — a solution later widely mocked as having become just as generic.

wiki_facts.other_names: Alegria, Big Tech Art Style, Blob Web, Globohomo, Humans of Flat
wiki_facts.key_motifs: Flat vector illustrations, disproportionate bodies (small heads, bendy limbs), pastel or vibrant solid colors, lack of facial features, geometric shapes
